name: No AI Slop
summary: Agent skill that removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from writing while keeping the author's voice.
description: A skill for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents that edits writing to remove 20+ AI slop patterns — binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, faux-insight setups, importance puffery and more — without flattening the author's vocabulary or cadence. It can edit, detect slop, or generate slop as satire, and installs by pasting a prompt into an agent or with npx.
contains: modes: edit writing, detect slop, generate slop for fun
ships as SKILL.md, eval.md and a ChatGPT/Codex plugin
